title: Implement Longest Common Subsequence in Rust
description: Implement lcs(s: &str, t: &str) -> usize returning the length of the longest common subsequence of s and t using bottom-up DP.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement lcs in src/lib.rs using bottom-up DP:
- Collect s and t into Vec<char>
- Allocate dp[m+1][n+1] all zeros
- For i=1..=m, j=1..=n: if s[i-1]==t[j-1], dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]+1; else dp[i][j]=max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
- Return dp[m][n]
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test --quiet` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
